def.zh-tw: 自然科學探究與實作的四個探究學習內容之一，包含分析資料和呈現證據、解釋和推理、提出結論或解決方案、建立模型四項；它和其他三項沒有固定的先後順序，可以來回循環。
def.en: One of the four inquiry strands of natural-science inquiry and practice, made up of analysing data and presenting evidence, explaining and reasoning, proposing conclusions or solutions, and building models; it has no fixed order with the other three strands and may cycle back and forth.
